steps.speaker: Expedition Member
steps.content: How's the mission going? Do you need more hands?
An expedition member stops the young diver with genuine concern on her face. But she just stands there, seemingly struggling to find the proper response.

steps.speaker: Expedition Member
steps.content: The contamination in these waters is getting out of hand, and there are monsters poppin' up all over the place lately. We're all just worried about you, you know.

steps.speaker: Expedition Member
steps.content: Alright, you're a stubborn one, aren't you? I get it, you're a pro underwater and all, but you should know that... it's usually the best swimmers who end up drowning...

steps.speaker: Expedition Member
steps.content: You skipped your routine checkup with Dr. Banyan, right? You're well aware of what's happening with the rest of the crew on this expedition.

steps.speaker: Expedition Member
steps.content: These missions keep you away for weeks at a time. I'm afraid one day I'll see you again and... not even recognize who you are anymore...
The senior colleague trails off awkwardly, catching herself.

steps.speaker: Expedition Member
steps.content: ...Never mind. I'm the one being totally blunt, rambling on about all these dreary stuff.

steps.speaker: Expedition Member
steps.content: Remember, if you need any help, tell us right away.
